item.tib: rtsa gsum bon skyongs bzhi sbrag las mtha'i mdel kha dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu dgra bgegs dpung 'joms
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang rtsa gsum bon skyongs bzhi sbrag gi bsgrub (sgrub) pa'i cha lag su (la) 'di ltar dgos zhes/ rang gi gcung po skam bla rnam rgyal tshul khrims gyis nye bar bskul ngor/ las byang nyung thus shams bsgyur mdel kha bcas/ sman ri'i mkhan ming pa nyi ri shel zhin gyis yi ger bkod pas bkra shis shing zhal dro bar gyur cig/
